_about: Comparable open-source projects for the peers lens (axes.tsv `peers`). Hand-kept; pushed_at verified 2026-10-01 (all active). `pain` names the clawock pain the project is worth reading for; `look_at` is where its mechanism lives; `boundary` is what NOT to port. The gate re-checks every cited repository is live (not archived, pushed within a year).

peers.pain: multi-currency book totals and FX conversion (HKD+USD must never be added raw), per-holding performance, stale market data marking
peers.look_at: exchange-rate service, portfolio calculator, data-provider fallback and 'data gathering' status

peers.pain: realized vs unrealized P&L, TTWROR/IRR denominators, corporate actions (splits, dividends) in cost basis
peers.look_at: performance snapshot calculations, currency conversion, split handling
peers.boundary: desktop app; borrow calculation rules, not UI

peers.pain: quote/fundamental provider fallback, normalised fields across providers, provider health
peers.look_at: provider interface, standard models, fetcher error handling
peers.boundary: no new paid providers without kcn

peers.pain: point-in-time data and look-ahead bias in decision snapshots and backtests
peers.look_at: PIT database, data health checks, backtest calendar handling
peers.boundary: no parameter search, no model zoo

peers.pain: bull/bear/judge debate quality, evidence citations, reflection memory from past decisions
peers.look_at: debate/researcher graph, reflection and memory modules
peers.boundary: no execution agent, no position auto-sizing beyond clawock's own policy

peers.pain: per-analyst signals combined into a decision with reasons, risk manager limits
peers.look_at: risk manager agent, portfolio manager aggregation

peers.pain: report generation from filings with verifiable numbers
peers.look_at: financial report agents, data source tooling

peers.pain: silent bad data: missing fields read as 0/empty, schema drift between writer and reader, freshness
peers.look_at: expectation suites, checkpoints, data docs (a failed check is visible, not silent)
peers.boundary: borrow the check shapes, not the framework

peers.pain: freshness / row-count / missing-value checks with warn vs fail thresholds
delivery watchdog: grace periods, late vs down, a missed brief vs a skipped holiday slot, false red alarms
peers.look_at: check states (new/up/grace/down), grace time, cron-expression schedules with time zones
peers.boundary: no per-failure push alerts to kcn (feedback: daily review instead of single-run alerts)

peers.pain: notification retry/dedup, maintenance windows (market holidays) that should not alarm
peers.look_at: maintenance windows, notification providers, retry intervals
peers.boundary: no new notification channels without kcn

peers.pain: the same failure alerting once per slot, a root cause and its symptoms alerting separately
peers.look_at: group_by / group_wait / repeat_interval, inhibition rules, silences
peers.boundary: borrow grouping semantics, not the server

peers.pain: degradation ledger rows that never age, recurring failures not grouped, regressions of fixed issues
peers.look_at: issue grouping/fingerprinting, regression detection (resolved → regressed), issue priority

peers.pain: LLM output quality drift in briefs (template leaks, field names, placeholder prose) measured over time
peers.look_at: text descriptors, LLM evals, test suites with thresholds

peers.pain: postflight gates bypassed by formatting, regressions when the model provider changes
peers.boundary: evaluate clawock's gates, do not add a second pipeline

peers.pain: which context field the model actually used, cost/latency per cron slot
peers.boundary: no hosted service; local ledgers only

peers.pain: Telegram status/report commands, protections (cooldown after losses, max drawdown guard) as auditable rules
peers.boundary: clawock does not trade: borrow reporting and guard semantics only

peers.pain: honest performance reporting: drawdown, benchmark-relative returns, opportunity cost
